business_problem: Jefferies wanted to modernize its infrastructure and then use cloud data and AI services to help bankers, traders, and sales teams surface better insights and advice for clients while controlling cost and operational complexity.
solution_summary: Jefferies used AWS first to modernize infrastructure and later as a platform for data and AI innovation across the investment bank. Foundational workloads moved onto Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, and AWS Backup so Jefferies could scale data centers and lower costs. On top of that base, the firm now uses Amazon RDS Custom for data services and applies Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon Q to build products that help salespeople, traders, and bankers surface better insights and advice for clients. This creates a progression from infrastructure modernization to intelligent workflows: core data and applications run in the cloud, governed backups protect them, customized databases support demanding financial applications, and AI services help employees turn firm data into differentiated client outcomes. The result is higher productivity inside the bank and a faster path to new products built on the same AWS foundation.

solution_components.role: Provides scalable infrastructure for Jefferies' modernized core environments.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Stores data supporting Jefferies' cloud-based innovation stack.

solution_components.name: AWS Backup
solution_components.role: Protects Jefferies workloads as they move into AWS.

solution_components.name: Amazon RDS Custom
solution_components.role: Supports customized database environments for financial applications and data services.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker
solution_components.role: Supports AI and machine-learning product development for banker and trader insights.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Provides generative-AI capabilities for new Jefferies products.

solution_components.name: Amazon Q
solution_components.role: Supports knowledge and productivity workflows for teams building and using Jefferies' AI tools.
